When the user has hit their bandwidth limit, we will need to specify what the user experience of using the browser while the VPN is on. I suggest that we block all navigation and show a network error page-style error that asks the user to upgrade to Mozilla VPN or turn the VPN off. We shouldn't disable the VPN automatically as it will remove a protection silently that the user has asked for.

Projecting the amount of time that remains based on historical bandwidth use adds a lot of complexity and isn't something that is offered today in Mozilla VPN. We can get this wrong and be more confusing to users than we are trying to be helpful.
